Corollary
[Critical Curves] ↗ thm:minimizing-geodesic-unit-speed 1. ch6:6.5

A unit-speed admissible curve is a critical point of $L_g$ if and only if it is a geodesic.

Proof

\sketch For a critical curve, the proof of Theorem 2 applies verbatim. Conversely, for a geodesic the integral in (6.2) vanishes because $D_t\gamma '=0$, and the jump sum vanishes because $\gamma '$ is smooth.

□
